title: Not quite as expected.
text: Not quite as expected.. Disappointed in this product. I love that is has 6  wheels to cut my cookie dough, but with only 1 nut to tighten the whole tool doesn't hold the spacing good enough. I thought this was the answer to my needs, but maybe and more expensive one would hold better. I used it once, but probably not again.
